name: arc-skim
description: Skim Claude's replies: Claude marks the few sentences you must read, the mod draws them highlighted and dims the rest, and strips the marks before the reply is stored. Based on ttqteo/claude-skim (MIT).

highlight.title: Skim: highlight must-read sentences
highlight.description: Ask Claude to mark the sentences of a long reply worth reading, and draw them highlighted. Off, Claude is not asked and the mod costs no tokens.

dim.title: Skim: dim the rest of an explanation
dim.description: Dim a long explanation around its highlighted sentences. /skim toggles it.
